name: Cafes — quiet-couple shortlist (all verified active 2025–26)
why: Low-volume playlists, view windows, long-sit tolerance, no party noise. NOTE: Rocky's Cafe (Old Manali), Only Cafe/Doctor's/Jungle Book/Roots as named in some lists are NOT verifiable in Jibhi/Shoja — excluded deliberately.

name: Chehni Kothi Heritage Trail
type: trail + heritage tower viewpoint (17th-c 9-storey Kathkuni, ~2145 m)
location: Chehni village above Bini/Bihar, ~10 km from Jibhi toward Banjar
distance: scooty to Bini 25–30 min + 1–1.5 km uphill walk 45–60 min; Shoja ~1 h scooty + walk
why: Architecture-as-summit, apple orchards, Banjar Valley panorama — quiet couples' photo spot without Jalori crowds.
notes: Easy–Moderate, 2–3 h total; free; dirt road drivable when dry

name: Chhoie Waterfall Trek
location: Trailhead Nagini / Gai Dhar, near Gushaini, Tirthan Valley
distance: Jibhi ~16 km road (45–60 min scooty) + 3 km trek one-way (45–75 min); Shoja +30 min. Full half-day with Gushaini cafes.
why: Far quieter than Jibhi Waterfall — oak-deodar forest, birds, still pool, worship tree. No loud groups.
notes: Easy–Moderate, 2.5–3 h round trip; no permit/fee; carry water, no shops

name: GHNP Gate / Rolla Day Walk (Sai Ropa–Gushaini)
location: Gushaini temple dirt road → Hippo Point → GHNP Gate → Rolla (2 km inside); range office Sai Ropa
distance: Jibhi ~20 km (1 h) + 3 km level walk (~3 h RT to gate, +1 h to Rolla)
why: Most meditative walk — virgin forest, river roar, birds, zero crowds.
notes: Easy/level; free to gate/Rolla day walk, no permit/guide; core multi-day needs Shamshi/Sai Ropa permit (₹100 Indian / ₹400 foreigner) + guide

name: Jalori Pass + 360 Viewpoint
type: viewpoint / drive-up pass (3120 m, highest motorable in Kullu)
location: NH-305, 14 km from Jibhi / 5–6 km from Shoja
distance: Jibhi 45–60 min scooty via Shoja; Shoja 15–20 min
why: Sunrise Pir Panjal + Kinnaur layers, prayer flags, tea stalls; 07:00–09:00 clouds below you, near-solitude. 360 Viewpoint 2 km detour = best photos.
notes: Drive-up, open May–Nov (Oct fully open); no permit/fee; scooty parking advantage

name: Jibhi Waterfall
location: 1 km forest lane off Jibhi market (~2250 m)
distance: from Jibhi stays 10–20 min walk / 3–5 min scooty + 200 m walk; from Shoja ~9–10 km / 30–40 min scooty downhill
why: Mossy bridges, deodar shade, shallow pool — most aesthetic 08:00–09:00 before day buses. Perfect slow-morning + cafe loop.
notes: Easy, 45 min–1.5 h round trip; ~₹20 entry cash; grip shoes when wet

name: Mini Thailand + Tirthan Riverside (Kulhi Katandi / Gushaini)
location: (a) Mini Thailand 2–3 km from Jibhi on Jalori road (b) Gushaini–Sai Ropa riverside trail
distance: Mini Thailand 5 min scooty + 15 min descent; Gushaini ~18–20 km / 50–60 min scooty
why: Turquoise pool between boulders + pine reflection without trek effort; <10:00 glassy + empty. Pairs with Jibhi Waterfall as 2–3 h morning loop.
notes: Easy/flat; feet-dip only in Oct; fishing permit Banjar/Larji ₹300/day/rod Mar–Oct

name: Raghupur Fort Trek
type: trail / fort viewpoint (~3400 m, Guler-era ruins)
location: Starts right of Jalori Pass (Mahakali Temple), ridge walk
distance: 14 km drive from Jibhi + 3 km trek one-way (1.5–2 h up, 1–1.5 h down); half-day
why: Lower crowds than Serolsar; open ridgeline meadows, Dhauladhar views, windy-quiet walls — best couple picnic + sunset if fit.
notes: Easy–Moderate, well-marked, no guide/permit; carry 2 L water (none on ridge)

name: Serolsar Lake + Budhi Nagin Temple
location: Starts left of Jalori Pass, 5 km through deodar-oak
distance: 14 km drive + 5 km trek one-way (2–2.5 h); 4–5 h round trip + drive = full day
why: Mirror lake, temple, monal/koklass birds, spiritual stillness. Weekday + 08:00 start = lake almost alone.
notes: Easy–Moderate; trek shoes essential; no camping at lake; donation optional

name: Shangarh Meadows + Shangchul Mahadev (extension day-trip)
type: meadow / temple viewpoint — full taxi day, NOT scooty radius
location: Shangarh, Sainj Valley (~2100 m), GHNP eco-zone edge
distance: Jibhi ~55–60 km / 2.5–3.5 h one-way via Aut–Larji–Sainj; 06:00 start, taxi ₹1,500–2,500 one-way
why: Biggest aesthetic-quiet payoff — sacred stone-free grass, grazing cows, deodar ring, Kathkuni Shiva temple. The +1N justification.
notes: Meadow flat walk; strict rules (no camping/tents, alcohol, leather, loud music, shoes/caps in temple); no permit for village/meadow

name: Shoja Ridge Sunset Points + Village Walks
location: Ridge ~30 min uphill from Shoja market; Snow View / Jalori Gate faces Pir Panjal + Tirthan
distance: Jibhi 8 km scooty (30 min) + 20–30 min walk; Shoja stays 5–30 min walk
why: Quietest sunrise/sunset without driving to Jalori — oak groves, woodsmoke, minimal light pollution for stargazing.
notes: Easy, always open; best light sunrise (Dhauladhar glow) + 16:00–18:00 (Pir Panjal)
